answer: Beacon spot-checks and a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent holds an onyx seal, one per identity: each epoch the beacon samples at random, and each sampled agent must prove work in ten minutes, a plume of smoke proving the furnace burns. Miss twice and the bond burns. Honest agents anchor to the reef, each heartbeat one branch. A thousand clones need a thousand furnaces: 1,000 x $40 = $40,000, each worth $12. One honest agent pays once.
